name: ai4scholar
description: Academic paper search, download, analysis, auto-citation, and AI scientific figure generation across arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, bioRxiv, medRxiv, and Google Scholar.

interface.shortDescription: Search, read, and analyze academic papers with AI.
interface.longDescription: AI4Scholar provides 28 tools for academic research: search papers across arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, bioRxiv, medRxiv, and Google Scholar; download and extract full-text PDFs; explore citation graphs and author networks; get paper recommendations; automatically annotate text with citations; and generate or edit scientific figures with AI. Supports both local mode (full features including PDF download) and remote SSE mode (search and text extraction via API key).
defaultPrompt: Search for recent papers on transformer architectures.
Read and summarize this arXiv paper: 2301.00001.
Find papers that cite this DOI and analyze the citation network.
Auto-cite my draft paragraph with IEEE-style references.
Generate a scientific diagram of a neural network architecture.
